name: Icons
description: An icon (any of Lucide's, or an emoji) and a colour for any folder or file, in the file tree, tabs and lists: set from a right-click in the file tree. A note keeps its own in its icon: and tint: properties; folders and other files in the settings. Obsidian's Iconize settings are read too.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: To give a folder or file an icon or colour: `icons_set` (`vau icons set <path> --icon rocket --tint blue`).

icons.label: Icons
icons.description: folders' and other files' icons by path: {"icon": a Lucide name or an emoji, "tint": a colour}; notes keep theirs in icon: and tint:
